title: Opening: her maiden and married name and birth year
summary: Mary Hoffman gives her name (Nadal, married Robert Hoffman 1940) and says she was born in 1888.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Do you want to ask me something?
Sure. I'd like to know your full name, please.
Well, you mean my married name or from childhood or what?
Well, I was Mary Nadal, N-A, capital D-A-L. And I've never been married but once, and that was through Robert Hoffman and that's what I've been all these years since 1940.
No, capital N and then a capital D-A-L.
N-A-D-A-L with a capital N and a capital D. It's a name that I'd never heard before.
Well, I don't know what anybody else ever did. Not either. And I don't know why. My father was a Kentucky man. And I don't know about the name really.

Move these earphones out of the way. All right. Sometimes they get too close to the microphone and it gives you a little funny noise there. A little, yeah. Well, you've told me your age once when the machine is off. Do you mind my asking it again?
Oh, no. I'm 87. I was 87 on the fourth day of December.
And let's see, what year would that make you?
